# Phase 4 Learning Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 4 (User Story 3 - Track learning resources) acceptance criteria AS1-AS7 and FR-012..FR-016 used by loop-3 testing: card fields and validation, milestones, notes, derived vs manual status, removal and UX states.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US3 acceptance criteria + validation/API errors + status derivation/manual status + UX states.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified whether card and milestone title whitespace is trimmed before the 1-200 length rule is applied? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a maximum length for the card description/source specified in the spec (not only in the data model)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the card fields that may be changed after creation (title, description, status) listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified whether milestone title and target date can be edited after creation? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the order of milestones and notes within a card specified? [Gap, Spec §US3 AS2]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the default list order of cards on the page specified? [Gap, Spec §US3 AS1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "progress" defined (formula, rounding, value with no milestones) for a card? [Clarity, Spec §US3 AS3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "toggle" in FR-016 defined so that an edit that does not change the done flag (title/date only) keeps a manual status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the status after removing the last milestone specified (recompute vs keep)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "non-empty" note text defined for whitespace-only input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the note timestamp display format and time zone specified? [Clarity, Spec §US3 AS4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Is the default status of a new card (Not Started) consistent between AS1, FR-012 and the "no milestones → status set manually only" edge case? [Consistency, Spec §US3 AS1, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are learning card title limits consistent between the spec (1-200) and the plan item `sourceTitle` snapshot used later? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can "the list and the card's progress update immediately" be objectively measured (latency or same-interaction update)? [Measurability, Spec §US3 AS3]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "the card with its milestones and notes is gone" verifiable at the data level (cascade removal)? [Measurability, Spec §US3 AS6]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are error responses (format, field naming) specified for invalid card, milestone and note input? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012..FR-015]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for acting on a milestone or note that belongs to another card or no longer exists? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are cancel-confirmation behaviours for card removal specified? [Coverage, Spec §US3 AS6]
- [ ] CHK019 Are failure/rollback requirements defined when a milestone toggle or removal fails on the server? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Is the behaviour for very long titles/notes (truncation plus full text) specified for both the card grid and expanded view? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified whether a milestone may be created already done, and what its completion time is? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK022 Are overdue target dates (past, not done) given any visual requirement? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are accessibility requirements (expanded state, keyboard operation of checkboxes and forms) specified for the expandable card? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are animation requirements (enter/leave, expand, strike-through) and reduced-motion behaviour specified? [Non-Functional, Spec §Input "great UI with good animations"]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the dependency of plans (US4) and the dashboard (US5) on learning card ids/status/milestone completion times documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-024, §US5 AS5]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
